SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


June 2ist, 1963 


HARRY DAVID PARNASS, B.A., A GRADUATE OF SIR GEORGE 
WILLIAMS UNIVERSITY IN 1957 HAS BEEN AWARDED THE 
WILLIA® KINNE FELLOWS TRAVELLING FELLOWSHIP BY THE 
SCHOOL OF ARCHITECTURE AT COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY. 


MR. PARNASS, A BEMBER OF THE GRADUATING CLASS AT THE 
COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY SCHOOL OF ARCHITECTURE WILL USE 
THE AWARD FOR A STUDY OF THE COASTAL ARCHITECTURE 

OF YUGOSLAVIA, GREECE, ANO NORTHERN ITALY. 


AR, PARNASS, A NATIVE OF GERMANY, EAIGRATED TO NEW 
YORK, AND CAME TO SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS UNIVERSITY IN 
1953, GRADUATING IN 1957. 


THE AWARD WHICH is VALUED AT $2,700 ENTITLES THE WINNER 
TO SIX MONTHS TRAVEL AND STUDY ABROAD.
